transcript: EV charger circuit installation for David Zhao at 67 Meadowbrook Lane. Put in a fifty-amp double pole breaker in the main panel. We ran thirty feet... no sorry, make that forty-five feet of 6/3 NM-B wire along the garage joists to the front wall. Installed one industrial NEMA 14-50 receptacle in a metal 2-gang box. The metal box was off the truck, not in the price list. Took three hours labor total.

expected.job_summary: EV charger 50A circuit and NEMA 14-50 outlet installation
expected.notes: Wire run along garage joists to front wall.
